sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Create an overall Change Management Strategy for the project with local adaption of the vision and mission. The elements of a Change Strategy are: situational awareness (understand the change and who is impacted), supporting structures (team and sponsor structures), and strategy analysis (risks, resistance, and special tactics).

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Ensures structured and consistent change management. Improves adoption and minimizes disruption. Aligns change efforts with business outcomes. Enhances readiness and resilience across the organization. Supports successful realization of transformation benefits.
